title: Inventory & Sales Tracker with Internet Identity login, product CRUD, sales recording, and dashboard alerts

requirements.text: Implement authentication using Internet Identity (passkey-based) and gate all app features behind a signed-in session.

quotes: User login & onboarding – email or phone OTP

acceptanceCriteria: User can sign in and sign out using Internet Identity.
When signed out, the user cannot view or mutate products/sales data.
All backend calls that read/write app data require an authenticated principal (or otherwise only operate on caller-owned data).

requirements.text: Add a simple onboarding/profile setup flow for first-time users after Internet Identity login (e.g., store display name and default low-stock threshold) and persist it per user principal.

quotes: User login & onboarding – email or phone OTP

acceptanceCriteria: First-time logged-in users are prompted to complete onboarding fields before accessing the main app.
Profile data persists across reloads and re-logins for the same Internet Identity principal.
Users can later update onboarding/profile fields from within the app.

requirements.text: Implement Product Management: create, list, edit, and delete products with fields sufficient for sales/profit calculations and low-stock alerts (at minimum: name, cost price, sale price, current stock quantity, low-stock threshold override or use default).
acceptanceCriteria: User can add a product and it appears in the product list after creation.
User can edit an existing product and changes persist.
User can delete a product and it is removed from the list and no longer available for new sales entries.
Validation prevents invalid numeric values (e.g., negative quantities/prices) and shows user-facing error messages in English.

requirements.text: Implement Sales Recording: provide a simple sales form to record a sale for a product (date/time, product, quantity, unit sale price optional override, unit cost price sourced from product, notes optional) and automatically compute profit for the sale; update inventory stock accordingly.

quotes: Sales recording – simple form, auto profit calculation

acceptanceCriteria: User can record a sale and it persists; the sale appears in a sales list/history view.
Profit is automatically calculated and stored/displayed (profit = (unitSalePrice - unitCostPrice) * quantity).
Recording a sale decrements the product stock by the sold quantity and prevents selling more than available stock (unless explicitly allowed; if not allowed, show an error).
User-facing numbers are displayed consistently (e.g., currency formatting if applicable) and all user-facing text is in English.

requirements.text: Create a Dashboard that shows (a) daily summary metrics for the selected day (e.g., total sales count, revenue, cost, profit) and (b) a low-stock alert list based on per-product threshold (product override or user default).

quotes: Dashboard – daily summary + low stock alert

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard loads after login and shows a clear daily summary for ‘today’ by default.
User can change the day (at least to previous days) and the summary updates accordingly.
Low-stock alert section lists products whose stock is at or below their threshold.
Dashboard data reflects recorded products and sales accurately after creating/editing records.

requirements.text: Add an optional Notifications settings area that clearly marks WhatsApp notifications as ‘not enabled in v1’ and provides a placeholder UI for future integration without attempting real WhatsApp API integration.

quotes: Notifications – WhatsApp integration optional for first version
Optional WhatsApp integration (frontend API calls only)

acceptanceCriteria: App includes a Notifications/Integrations section that mentions WhatsApp is optional and not active in v1.
No real WhatsApp messages are sent; the UI must not require external credentials to function.
Any future-facing controls are disabled or clearly labeled as placeholders.

requirements.text: Define and apply a cohesive, distinctive visual theme for the app (colors, typography, spacing, component style) and use it consistently across onboarding, products, sales, and dashboard screens (avoid blue/purple as primary colors).
acceptanceCriteria: All main screens share consistent typography, spacing, and component styling.
Primary color palette does not use blue/purple as the main brand colors.
Layout is responsive and usable on mobile and desktop.

constraints: Use Internet Identity for authentication; do not implement email OTP or phone/SMS OTP.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).

Do not modify any frontend paths marked immutable by the system (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing email delivery, SMS/phone OTP, or any other non-Internet-Identity authentication.
Building a real WhatsApp integration that sends messages (v1 should be placeholder only).
Adding external databases or third-party backend services.
